doc.title: Eddie Palmieri — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Church, marriage into Protestantism and belief
summary: A short exchange on the church where he married and his view of belief.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Protestant. I was Catholic, but I married a Protestant. I don’t believe in the Protestant, this-and-that... It’s what you believe. The word is “believe.” If someone asked me, “Do you believe in God?” and I say, “No.” I say, “Do you believe in God?” He goes, “Yes.” To me, it means the same. We both believe. I learned that a little later, though.
